gloss: to get used to a situation; to feel at ease

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {場馴|ばな}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to get used to a situation; to feel at ease in a setting
definitions.explanation: To become accustomed to a particular environment or situation through experience, so that one can act calmly and naturally without nervousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{場馴|ばな}れ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That person is used to these kinds of situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{場馴|ばな}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After giving presentations many times, I've gotten completely used to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{場馴|ばな}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Despite being a newcomer, she gave the speech confidently with a relaxed manner.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the form {場馴|ばな}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (adjective form) or {場馴|ばな}れ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (stative form) to describe someone who appears calm and experienced. Can also be written as {場慣|ばな}れ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場馴|ばな}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (an experienced, composed manner)
- {場馴|ばな}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧ (an at-ease appearance)
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{場馴|ばな}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become completely at ease)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to — general term for becoming accustomed to anything
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be composed — describes confident behavior without implying experience
